act.long_title: An Act to provide for protection of the interests of consumers and for the said purpose, to establish authorities for timely and effective administration and settlement of consumers' disputes and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto
act.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

instruments.title: The Tamil Nadu Consumer Protection (Appointment, Salary, Allowances and conditions of service of president and members of the State Commission and District Forum) Rules,2018

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Salaries, allowances and other terms and conditions of service of President and members of District Commission
section.html: The State Government may, by notification, make rules to provide for salaries and allowances and other terms and conditions of service of the President, and members of the District Commission.
section.text: The State Government may, by notification, make rules to provide for salaries and allowances and other terms and conditions of service of the President, and members of the District Commission.
